page_title: OSA 2-2 MAL | Osasuna v Mallorca 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) fails to keep his cool and squanders a golden chance to score from inside the penalty area after firing the ball over the crossbar.
90+5' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca) for a tough tackle.
90+4' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Moi Gomez provided an assist for the goal.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 2 Wonderful movement! Kike Barja (Osasuna) perfectly times his run onto a brilliant cross and smashes the ball from deep inside the box straight into the roof of the net. What a finish.
88' Martin Demichelis decides to make a substitution. Mateo Joseph will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Pablo Maffeo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Alejandro Hernandez lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
86' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has a goal ruled out for offside!
85' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Alejandro Hernandez produces a RED card from his pocket and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) heads for an early shower!

82' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Raul Garcia (Osasuna), but referee Alejandro Hernandez must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
81' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
77' Substitution. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Javi Galan walks off.
77' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Jorge Herrando and he is replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
77' That will be all from Jon Moncayola who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kike Barja (Osasuna).
76' A cross from a corner kick by Osasuna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
73' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Alejandro Hernandez sends him off the pitch.
72' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
71' A lofted pass into the box is met by Victor Munoz (Osasuna), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
69' The referee shows the yellow card to Leo Roman (Mallorca).
68' The attendance for today's match is 19746.
64' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Javi Galan (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Jan Virgili (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Manu Morlanes.
61' 0 - 2 Goal! Sergi Darder plays a long ball to Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:2.
60' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) receives a yellow card for infringement.
56' Here is a change. Ruben Garcia is going off and Alessio Lisci gives the last tactical orders to Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
56' Today's match ends for Lucas Torro who will be replaced by Raul Moro (Osasuna).
55' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' Javi Galan (Osasuna) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Osasuna will take a corner kick.
53' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pablo Torre limps off the pitch to be replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
53' The manager makes a subsitution with David Lopez (Mallorca) coming on for Antonio Raillo.
52' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Leo Roman is alert and denies him.
51' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Alejandro Hernandez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom of the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
40' Alessio Lisci isn't happy on the touchline after referee Alejandro Hernandez shows him a yellow card.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! A defensive error presents Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) with a great chance and he takes advantage of it by heading the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.

33' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
27' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
24' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
23' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
15' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
8' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is caught offside!
6' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
6' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick to Mallorca.
5' Mallorca are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Alejandro Hernandez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
